colour_palette.details: Vibrant retro tiki poolside aesthetic with custom tropical tones and high-contrast styling.

logo.details: Vectorized SVG palm tree logo asset ('PB_Palmtree logo.svg') with matching vector illustrations.

typography.details: Configured with Google Fonts 'Belanosima' (weights 300 to 700) matching their vintage resort vibe.

contact.details: Direct phone line, Google Maps routing link, and newsletter capture form.

online_presence.details: Modern Webflow architecture with Finsweet CMS slider attributes, clean Open Graph metadata, and responsive media.

verdict.commercial_rationale: Pool Burger already has a high-quality Webflow website with custom branding, vector assets, and typography. Not a qualified candidate for redesign outreach.

sample_website.notes: Excluded: Site is already well-designed and maintained.
